summary: Intelligent Group Limited filed a Form 6-K announcing board changes effective September 3, 2026: appointment of Dr. Jialin Lu as independent director and committee member/chair of nominating committee, and resignation of Ms. Sha Ye as independent director, stated not due to any disagreement. No financial terms, advisors, or takeover mechanics involved. The board will comprise nine members post-change. This is a routine board transition, not a disruptive CEO/CFO departure; nonetheless, classified as Management Changes per the specific event announcement. What to watch: subsequent board composition and governance impacts; risk-arb angle nil.
